analysis.content_limit: Full versus compressed changes all discarded text, including length and other advice; a difference does not isolate one specific advice type
analysis.decision: A strictly positive 95% bootstrap improvement interval supports advantage in these tested conditions; otherwise unresolved or negative; no parameter refit in this batch
analysis.primary: Fixed presence-model joint five-class Brier versus fixed constant; task-balanced means in each phase; task-bootstrap differences with 20000 resamples, seed 2026102305
analysis.probability_limit: One paired seed per task; a single trajectory discordance is not proof of unequal stochastic kernels
analysis.secondary: Success Brier, joint log loss, paired middle-versus-edge and native-versus-compressed success tables; report native E/U/C strata with C limited to two source cases
analysis.semantic: Full-text Codex E/C/U/A annotation by hash; keep A as an outcome; prior source labels remain unchanged
analysis.unit: 12 known base tasks with nested conditions/source texts; condition transport, not independent-task generalization

native_selection: Within each task and each unambiguous E/C/U source label, choose the minimum reflection hash from all prior failed cells; exclude A sources; no selection using new outcomes
reuse: Native E/C controls are the new middle cells; native U controls are the prior full-generic cells at the same task/seed/trial, source identities and inputs audited; controls are not new independent tasks
